By leveraging a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), TSC divides the private key into multiple key shards, each stored on a different device. This strategy ensures the security of the private key; even if one device is compromised, the attacker cannot obtain the full private key information. Additionally, CoinsDo's TSC solution enables users to establish their own TEE environment on AWS, further optimizing security.

TSC is adaptable to various use cases.
